40000.meaning1: valuing understanding; giving weight to wisdom

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.
katamāni cattāri? sīl'aggaṃ, samādhi'ggaṃ, paññā'ggaṃ, vimutt'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.

40002.commentary: (MNa) paññācakkhunā pajānātī'ti dassanapariṇāyak'aṭṭhena cakkhubhūtāya paññāya pajānāti. tattha dve paññā samādhipaññā vipassanāpaññā ca. samādhipaññāya kiccato asammohato ca pajānāti. vipassanāpaññāya lakkhaṇapaṭivedhena ārammaṇato jānanaṃ kathitaṃ.

examples.text: neyyaṃ pan'āvuso, dhammaṃ kena pajānātī'ti? neyyaṃ kho, āvuso, dhammaṃ paññācakkhunā pajānātī'ti.

katame cattāro? rāgavepullattaṃ, dosavepullattaṃ, mohavepullattaṃ, gambhīresu kho pan'assa ṭhān'āṭhānesu paññācakkhu na kamati. yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi.

40003.meaning1: endowed with wisdom; living by understanding
40003.commentary: (SNt) paññājīvī'ti paññāya jīvanasīlo'ti paññājīvī, paññāpubbaṅ'gamacariyo'ti attho. paññājīvī'ti ca paññāvasena iriyati vattati jīvitaṃ pavattetī'ti attho'ti

examples.text: saddh'īdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham'āvahati, saccaṃ have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ, paññājīviṃ jīvitam'āhu seṭṭhan'ti.
niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

40005.meaning1: characteristic feature; recognizable sign; distinctive mark

examples.text: kiṃsu rathassa paññāṇaṃ, kiṃsu paññāṇam'aggino, kiṃsu raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, kiṃsu paññāṇam'itthiyā'ti.

40006.commentary: (MNa) sīlapaññāṇan'ti sīlañ'ca ñāṇañ'ca na jānāsi. (SNa) dutiye paññāyati etenā'ti paññāṇaṃ.

examples.text: na hi pana tvaṃ, tāta bhadramukha, tassa bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jānāsi. sace tvaṃ, tāta bhadramukha, tassa bhagavato sīlapaññāṇaṃ jāneyyāsi, na tvaṃ, tāta bhadramukha, taṃ bhagavantaṃ akkositabbaṃ paribhāsitabbaṃ maññeyyāsī'ti.

40007.meaning1: characteristic feature of fire; recognizable sign of fire

examples.text: kiṃsu rathassa paññāṇaṃ, kiṃsu paññāṇam'aggino, kiṃsu raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, kiṃsu paññāṇam'itthiyā'ti.
dhajo rathassa paññāṇaṃ, dhūmo paññāṇam'aggino, rājā raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, bhattā paññāṇam'itthiyā'ti.

40008.meaning1: characteristic feature of a woman; recognizable sign of a woman
40008.commentary: (SNa) cakkavattirañño dhītā'pi pana itthī asukassa nāma bhariyā'ti bhattāraṃ patvā'va paññāyati.

examples.text: kiṃsu rathassa paññāṇaṃ, kiṃsu paññāṇam'aggino, kiṃsu raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, kiṃsu paññāṇam'itthiyā'ti.
dhajo rathassa paññāṇaṃ, dhūmo paññāṇam'aggino, rājā raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, bhattā paññāṇam'itthiyā'ti.

40009.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññū, vibhāvī, sapañña, sappañña

examples.text: nirāsaso so na ca āsasāno, paññāṇavā so na ca paññakappī, evam'pi todeyya muniṃ vijāna, akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattan'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kesiṃ assadammasārathiṃ bhagavā etadavoca, tvaṃ kho'si, kesi, paññāto assadammasārathī'ti. kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, kesi, assadammaṃ vinesī'ti?
anomanāmaṃ nipuṇ'atthadassiṃ, paññādadaṃ kām'ālaye asattaṃ, taṃ passatha sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, ariye pathe kamamānaṃ mahesin'ti.

40014.meaning1: wealth that is wisdom; treasure of understanding
40014.commentary: (DNa) sampatti-paṭilābh'aṭṭhena saddhā'va dhanaṃ saddhādhanaṃ. esa nayo sabbattha. paññādhanaṃ pan'ettha sabbaseṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, paññādhanaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā

40015.meaning1: having understanding as a basis; with wisdom as foundation; established in knowledge

examples.text: catur'ādhiṭṭhāno ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? paññ'ādhiṭṭhāno, sacc'ādhiṭṭhāno, cāg'ādhiṭṭhāno, upasam'ādhiṭṭhāno.
tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena paññ'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. esā hi, bhikkhu, paramā ariyā paññā yadidaṃ, sabbadukkhakkhaye ñāṇaṃ.

40016.meaning1: ruled by understanding; governed by wisdom

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.

40017.meaning1: which obstructs wisdom; which impedes understanding
40017.commentary: (MNa) paññānirodhiko'ti anuppannāya lokiyalok'uttarāya paññāya uppajjituṃ na deti, lokiyapaññaṃ pana aṭṭhasamāpatti-pañc'ābhiññā-vasena uppannam'pi samucchinditvā khipatī'ti paññānirodhiko.

examples.text: byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko'ti'pi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati.

40018.grammar: masc, agent, in comps, from paññapeti, caus (+gen)

examples.text: ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo

40019.commentary: (PMa) obhāsan'aṭṭhena paññā'va obhāso paññāobhāso. pajjotan'aṭṭhena paññā'va pajjoto paññāpajjoto.

examples.text: katame cattāro? candapajjoto, sūriyapajjoto, aggipajjoto, paññāpajjoto, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro pajjotā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ catunnaṃ pajjotānaṃ yadidaṃ paññāpajjoto'ti.

dukkhaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūri medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi, idaṃ vuccati dukkhe ñāṇaṃ.

40020.meaning1: who removed the darkness of ignorance with the lamp of wisdom; whose darkness of delusion has been dispelled by the light of understanding
40020.meaning2: who removed the darkness of ignorance with the light of wisdom
40020.commentary: (DNt) muyhanti tena, sayaṃ vā muyhati, mohanamattam'eva vā tan'ti moho, avijjā, sv'eva visayasabhāvapaṭicchādanato andhakārasarikkhatāya tamo viyā'ti tamo, paññāpajjotavihato mohatamo etassā'ti paññāpajjotavihatamohatamo, taṃ paññāpajjotavihatamohatamaṃ.
40020.sanskrit: prajñā + pradyota + vihata + moha, mogha + tamas

examples.text: karuṇāsītalahadayaṃ, paññāpajjotavihatamohatamaṃ, sanar'āmaralokagaruṃ, vande sugataṃ gativimuttaṃ.

40021.meaning1: obtaining wisdom; acquiring knowledge; gaining understanding
40021.commentary: (SNa) paññāpaṭilābhāya saṃvattantī'ti ettha satta sekkhā paññaṃ paṭilabhanti nāma, khīṇ'āsavo paṭiladdhapañño nāmā'ti veditabbo. parato paññābuddhiyā'ti-ādīsupi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipatti, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paññāpaṭilābhāya saṃvattantī'ti.

40022.meaning1: done for the sake of obtaining wisdom; done for the purpose of acquiring knowledge

examples.text: paññāpaṭilābhakatena kammunā, manussabhūto sukhumacchavī ahu, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, sukhumāni atthāni avecca dakkhiti.

40023.meaning1: gone for the sake of obtaining wisdom; gone for the purpose of acquiring knowledge

examples.text: paññāpaṭilābhagatena kammunā, manussabhūto sukhumacchavī ahu, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, sukhumāni atthāni avecca dakkhiti.
ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā. ye suvimuttā, te kevalino. ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāya.

40029.grammar: nt, dat sg of paññāpana, caus (+gen)
40029.meaning1: to describe; to define; to designate
40029.meaning2: to describe; to declare; for definition; designation
40029.construction:
pa + ñāpe + ana + āya
paññāpana + āya
40029.commentary: (MNa) vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāyā'ti tesaṃ vaṭṭaṃ apaññattibhāvaṃ gataṃ nippaññattikaṃ jātaṃ. evarūpo mahākhīṇ'āsavo evaṃ svākkhāte sāsane'y'eva uppajjati. yathā ca khīṇ'āsavo, evaṃ anāgāmiādayo'pi.

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya? ko hetu ko paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya?
rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā. ye suvimuttā, te kevalino. ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāya.

40030.meaning1: light of wisdom; radiance of understanding

examples.text: katamā catasso? candappabhā, sūriyappabhā, aggippabhā, paññāpabhā, imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso pabhā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ pabhānaṃ yadidaṃ paññāpabhā'ti.
ekadhammo, bhikkhave, bhāvito bahulīkato paññāpabhedāya saṃvattati… anupādāparinibbānāya saṃvattati. katamo ekadhammo?

40033.meaning1: (of a seat, water, etc.) preparing; setting out
40033.commentary: (MNa) sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā'ti attano attano ācariy'upajjhāyānaṃ vasanaṭṭhānāni pucchitvā dvāravātapānāni vivaritvā mañcapīṭhakaṭasārak'ādīni nīharitvā papphoṭetvā yathāṭṭhāne saṇṭhāpayamānā.

examples.text: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.

40034.meaning1: cleansed by understanding; purified by wisdom

examples.text: sīlapaññāṇañ'ca pana lokasmiṃ aggam'akkhāyati. seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, hatthena vā hatthaṃ dhoveyya, pādena vā pādaṃ dhoveyya, evam'eva kho, brāhmaṇa, sīlaparidhotā paññā, paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ. yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.

40035.meaning1: nurtured by wisdom; fortified by understanding; matured by knowledge

examples.text: samādhiparibhāvitā paññā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā. paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ samma'd'eva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyath'idaṃ, kām'āsavā, bhav'āsavā, avijj'āsavā'ti.
yassa kassaci, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ…

40036.meaning1: loss of wisdom; decline in understanding
40036.commentary: (ANa) yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti yā esā mama sāsane kammassakatapaññāya jhānapaññāya vipassanāpaññāya maggapaññāya phalapaññāya ca parihāni, esā pacchimā, esā lāmakā, esā chaḍḍanīyā'ti attho.

examples.text: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, parihāni yadidaṃ ñātiparihāni. etaṃ patikiṭṭhaṃ, bhikkhave, parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti.

40038.meaning2: highest state of understanding; perfection of wisdom

40039.meaning1: perfection of wisdom; culmination of understanding

examples.text: oḷārikassa'pi kho ahaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attapaṭilābhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi… paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā'ti.
yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodānīyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti, paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā'ti.

40040.meaning1: palace of understanding; tower of wisdom

examples.text: pamādaṃ appamādena, yadā nudati paṇḍito, paññāpāsādam'āruyha, asoko sokiniṃ pajaṃ, pabbataṭṭho'va bhūmaṭṭhe, dhīro bāle avekkhati.
ta'y'idaṃ āyasmatā khemakena tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkatan'ti.

40044.grammar: prp of paññapiyati, caus, pass, intrans (+instr)
40044.meaning1: (of a rule) being formulated; being prescribed; being decreed; being declared (by)
40044.meaningLit: being caused to be actively known

examples.text: evam'pi kho ahaṃ, bhante, na ussahāmi bhuñjituṃ, evam'pi hi me, bhante, bhuñjato siyā kukkuccaṃ, siyā vippaṭisāro'ti. atha kho āyasmā bhaddāli bhagavatā sikkhāpade paññāpiyamāne bhikkhusaṅghe sikkhaṃ samādiyamāne anussāhaṃ pavedesi.

40045.meaning2: causes to be described is made manifest
40045.meaningLit: is caused to be actively known
40045.base: √ñā + āpe + īya > ñāpīya > ñapīya (caus, pass, irreg)

40046.meaning1: (of a seat, water, etc.) should be prepared; should be set out
40046.meaningLit: to cause to be actively known

examples.text: buddhānañ'hi majjhimaṭṭhāne āsanaṃ paññāpetvā tassa dakkhiṇato sāriputtattherassa, vāmato mahāmoggallānattherassa, tato paṭṭhāya ubhosu passesu bhikkhusaṅghassa āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ hoti.
evaṃ kusal'ākusala-sāvajj'ānavajja-sevitabb'āsevitabba-hīnapaṇīta-kaṇhasukka-sappaṭibhāgānaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāpetāraṃ.
santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ paññāpenti.
api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpenti. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.

40050.grammar: pr, caus of pajānāti, impers, trans (+acc)

examples.text: so vat'āvuso, cakkhusmiṃ sati rūpe sati cakkhuviññāṇe sati phassapaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti

40051.meaning1: (of a seat, water, etc.) prepares; sets out

examples.text: tāta, ayyo, me anuruddhatthero āgato, yāv'assa añño koci pattaṃ na gaṇhāti, tāv'assa gantvā pattaṃ gaṇha, ahaṃ āsanaṃ paññāpessāmī'ti

40052.meaning1: (of a rule) formulates; prescribes; decrees; declares
40052.meaning2: regulates or make a rule, promulgates

examples.text: yato ca kho, bhaddāli, idh'ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃ'y'eva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.

40053.meaning1: to define; to delineate; to describe

examples.text: yā c'āvuso, paññā yañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā udāhu visaṃsaṭṭhā? labbhā ca pan'imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetun'ti?
sakkā evam'evaṃ viññāṇam'p'idaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ iti'p'idaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattā'ti.

40054.meaning1: (of a seat, water, etc.) having prepared; having set out; having laid out

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā kumbhakār'āvesanaṃ pavisitvā ekam'antaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ paññāpetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno.

40055.meaning2: having regulated or made a rule, having made known, having declared

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpenti. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimokkho.

40057.meaning2: regulating or making a rule, preparing (a seat, etc.)

40058.meaning1: prepared; arranged; set out (a seat, water, etc.)

examples.text: disvāna āsanaṃ paññāpesi udakañ'ca pādānaṃ

40059.meaning2: regulated or made a rule, made known, declared

40060.meaning1: power that is insight; strength of intelligence

examples.text: yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo sammādiṭṭhi magg'aṅgaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.

40061.meaningLit: discourse on the strength of wisdom

40062.meaning1: state of immense understanding; fact of having abundant wisdom
40062.commentary: (PM) paññābāhullāya saṃvattantī'ti katamaṃ paññābāhullaṃ? idh'ekacco paññāgaruko hoti paññ'ācarito paññ'āsayo paññ'ādhimutto paññādhajo paññāketu paññ'ādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo okkhāyanabahulo samokkhāyanabahulo sampekkhāyanadhammo vibhūtavihārī taccarito taggaruko tabbahulo tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo. yathā gaṇagaruko vuccati gaṇabāhuliko'ti, cīvaragaruko vuccati cīvarabāhuliko'ti, pattagaruko vuccati pattabāhuliko'ti, sen'āsanagaruko vuccati sen'āsanabāhuliko'ti, evam'evaṃ idh'ekacco paññā garuko hoti paññ'ācarito paññ'āsayo paññ'ādhimutto paññādhajo paññāketu paññ'ādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo okkhāyanabahulo samokkhāyanabahulo sampekkhāyanadhammo vibhūtavihārī taccarito taggaruko tabbahulo tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo. paññābāhullāya saṃvattantī'ti, idaṃ paññābāhullaṃ.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paññābāhullā saṃvattantī'ti.

40064.meaning1: increase of wisdom; development of understanding
40064.commentary: (PM) paññābuddhiyā saṃvattantī'ti katamā paññābuddhi? sattannañ'ca sekkhānaṃ puthujjanakalyāṇakassa ca paññā vaḍḍhati, arahato paññā vaḍḍhati. vaḍḍhitavaḍḍhanā paññābuddhiyā saṃvattantī'ti, ayaṃ paññābuddhi.

examples.text: sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhamm'ānudhammapaṭipatti, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paññāpaṭilābhāya saṃvattanti, paññābuddhiyā saṃvattanti … nibbedhikapaññatāya saṃvattanti.

40065.construction:
paññā + vuddhi > buddhi + iya
paññābuddhi + iya

examples.text: upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgo, bhikkhave, cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññābuddhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko. ime kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjh'aṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññābuddhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikā'ti.
katamā catasso? cand'ābhā, sūriy'ābhā, agg'ābhā, paññ'ābhā, imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso ābhā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ ābhānaṃ yadidaṃ paññ'ābhā'ti.
tisso bhāvanā, kāyabhāvanā, cittabhāvanā, paññābhāvanā.

40068.meaning1: made of wisdom; made of understanding; forged by insight

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.
kadā nu paññāmayam'uggatejaṃ, satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahas'ādiyitvā, māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīh'āsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

40069.meaning2: with wisdom; from sufficient measure of wisdom

examples.text: tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, api c'assa ime dhammā honti

40070.commentary: (ANa) paññāy'atthaṃ vipassatī'ti sahavipassanāya maggapaññāya catunnaṃ saccānaṃ atthaṃ vinivijjhitvā passati.

examples.text: yo ca sīlena sampanno, sutavā paṭibhānavā, saññato dhīro dhammesu, paññāy'atthaṃ vipassati.

40071.meaning1: by wisdom; with intelligence; by understanding; with insight

examples.text: yāni sotāni lokasmiṃ, sati tesaṃ nivāraṇaṃ, sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūmi, paññāya-ete pidhiyyare.
te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti. tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ anupaparikkhataṃ na nijjhānaṃ khamanti.

40072.meaning1: is clearly known; is evident; is perceived; there is

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇāni. katamāni tīṇi? uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati. imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇānī'ti.

yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

40073.meaning1: is allowed; is permitted (to); is known

examples.text: maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati. yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
paññāyissasi kho tvaṃ, moghapurisa, etena sakena pāpakena diṭṭhigatena. idh'āhaṃ bhikkhū paṭipucchissāmī'ti.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, alaṃ dāni me aḍḍakaraṇena, bhadramukho dāni aḍḍakaraṇena paññāyissatī'ti.

40076.synonym: āgacchati, okkamati, kamati, niccharati, pavattati, byeti, vattati, samudācarati, sambhavati, sambhuṇāti, saṃvattati

examples.text: tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro antepuraṃ gato dukkhī dummano pajjhāyati, dhi'r'atthu kira, bho, jāti nāma, yatra hi nāma jātassa jarā paññāyissatī'ti!

40077.commentary: (DNt) na paññāyamānāni na dissamānāni chaḍḍetabbāni vajjitabbāni na gahetabbāni.

examples.text: na c'eva sutte osarantī'ti suttapaṭipāṭiyā katthaci anāgantvā challiṃ uṭṭhapetvā guḷhavessantara-guḷhaummagga-guḷhavinaya-vedallapiṭakānaṃ aññatarato āgatāni paññāyantī'ti attho. evaṃ āgatāni hi rāg'ādivinaye ca na paññāyamānāni chaḍḍetabbāni honti.
jhāyamānassa kho pana bhagavato sarīrassa yaṃ ahosi chavī'ti vā camman'ti vā maṃsan'ti vā nhārū'ti vā lasikāti vā, tassa n'eva chārikā paññāyittha, na masi, sarīrān'eva avasissiṃsu.
taṃ kiṃ maññati bhavaṃ vessavaṇo mahārājā atītam'pi addhānaṃ evarūpo uḷāro satthā ahosi, evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ dhamm'akkhānaṃ, evarūpā uḷārā vises'ādhigamā paññāyiṃsu.

40080.meaning1: having become clear; having become evident
40080.meaning2: having appeared, having cleared or evident

40081.meaning1: taking pleasure in peace of wisdom; enjoying the tranquillity of understanding
40081.commentary: (JAa) paññāy'ūpasame ratā'ti maggen'eva āgatapaññāya kiles'ūpasame ratā, yathā vā sīlena, evaṃ paññāya'pi sampannā, kiles'ūpasame ratā'ti'pi attho.

examples.text: ye ca sīlena sampannā, paññāy'ūpasameratā, upasantā sukhaṃ senti, nāsayitvāna makkhikāti.

40082.grammar: opt, reflx 3rd sg of paññāyeyya, impers, pass, intrans
40082.meaning1: it would be apparent; it would be evident; it could be discerned

examples.text: kāmadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho kāmabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante
ettako ce'pi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.

40083.meaning1: light of wisdom; light of understanding

examples.text: katame cattāro? cand'āloko, sūriy'āloko, agg'āloko, paññ'āloko, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro ālokā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ catunnaṃ ālokānaṃ yadidaṃ paññ'āloko'ti.

40084.construction:
pañca + dasa + ā + a
paññāsā + a

examples.text: paññāsaṃ ca diyaḍḍhasataṃ, dve ca veyyākaraṇaṃ apare ca, tevanāmagataṃ ca anupubbaṃ, ekamanā nisāmetha mud'aggaṃ.

40085.meaning2: ?? investigation into the accumulation of wisdom

40087.commentary: (SNa) paññāya ca samā ābhā nāma n'atthi. sūriy'ādayo hi ekadesaṃ'y'eva obhāsanti, paccuppannam'eva ca tamaṃ vinodenti. paññā pana dasasahassim'pi lokadhātuṃ ekappajjotaṃ kātuṃ sakkoti, atīt'aṃs'ādipaṭicchādakañ'ca tamaṃ vidhamati.

examples.text: n'atthi attasamaṃ pemaṃ, n'atthi dhaññasamaṃ dhanaṃ, n'atthi paññāsamā ābhā, vuṭṭhi ve paramā sarā'ti.

40088.construction:
pañca + dasa + ā + ma
paññāsā + ma

40089.meaning1: attainment of knowledge; success in understanding; being accomplished in wisdom

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca paññāsampanno paññāsampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, paññāsampadaṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.

40090.meaning1: talk about attaining wisdom; discussion about success in understanding

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca paññāsampanno paññāsampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

40091.meaning1: full of wisdom; accomplished in understanding

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca paññāsampanno paññāsampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

40092.meaning1: more full of wisdom; more accomplished in understanding (than)
40092.commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake … attanā paññāsampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.

40093.meaning1: fifty yojanas; approximately one thousand kilometres

examples.text: sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pokkharaṇī paññāsayojanāni āyāmena paññāsayojanāni vitthārena paññāsayojanāni ubbedhena, puṇṇā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā. tato puriso kus'aggena udakaṃ uddhareyya.

40095.meaning1: fifty years of age; fifty years old

examples.text: vīsam'pi jātiyo tiṃsam'pi jātiyo cattālīsam'pi jātiyo paññāsam'pi jātiyo jātisatam'pi, jātisahassam'pi jātisatasahassam'pi

dasa'pi, bhante, purisā, vīsam'pi, bhante, purisā, tiṃsam'pi, bhante, purisā, cattārīsam'pi, bhante, purisā, paññāsam'pi, bhante, purisā nappahonti yāvatikā imissā nāḷandāya pāṇā te ekena khaṇena ekena muhuttena ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kātuṃ.

40097.meaning1: having common understanding; with similar wisdom

examples.text: samādhisāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ samādhikathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati. paññāsāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ paññākathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissatī'ti. tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
katame cattāro? sīlasāro, samādhisāro, paññāsāro, vimuttisāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro sārā'ti.

te sāran'ti te pana taṃ micchādiṭṭhiggahaṇaṃ gahetvā ṭhitā kāmavitakk'ādīnaṃ vasena micchāsaṅkappagocarā hutvā sīlasāraṃ, samādhisāraṃ, paññāsāraṃ, vimuttisāraṃ, vimuttiñāṇadassanasāraṃ, param'atthasāraṃ, nibbānañ'ca n'ādhigacchanti.

40099.meaning1: wisdom and virtue; understanding and moral integrity

examples.text: yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.
